decisions.reason: The cleaning soap is a low-cost accessory that complements the firm's flooring range and is publicly listed, so the firm has little reason to drop it after only one year.
The maintenance oil supports the firm's oiled-floor offer and its maintenance services, so it is central to the announced customer journey and likely to be retained.
The care product for oiled floors fits the established care line, and any weak early results can still be blamed on the short time on the market.
The moisture-protection underlay is a natural add-on to floor installation, so it reinforces the system offer and the firm's commitment to it.
Despite some overlap with the other underlay, the high-density foam broadens the system choice and was only recently committed to, so the firm is likely to persist with it.
The oak parquet is a core product with substantial production investment and visible commitment, making its withdrawal very unlikely.
